#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

class ManualScanner {
    istream& in;
public:
    ManualScanner(istream& in) : in(in) {}

    int readRaw() {
        return in.get();
    }

    bool isDelimiter(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\f' || c == ',';
    }

    string nextToken() {
        int c = readRaw();
        while (c != -1 && isDelimiter(c)) {
            c = readRaw();
        }
        if (c == -1) {
            return string();
        }
        string sb;
        while (c != -1 && !isDelimiter(c)) {
            sb += (char)c;
            c = readRaw();
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(nextToken());
    }

    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(nextToken());
    }
};

class MetroSolver {
    int n, m, s;
    long long t;

    int floorMod(int x, int y) {
        int r = x % y;
        if (r < 0) r += y;
        return r;
    }

    void advance() {
        int jump = (int)(t % n);
        t--;
        int dir = s < m ? 1 : -1;
        s = floorMod(s + dir * jump, n);
    }

    void advanceCycle() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            advance();
        }
    }

public:
    void solve(ManualScanner& in, ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();
        s = in.nextInt() - 1;
        t = in.nextLong();

        while (t % n != 0) {
            advance();
        }

        vector<long long> memory(n, -1LL);
        while (t != 0) {
            advanceCycle();
            if (memory[s] != -1LL) {
                long long interval = memory[s] - t;
                t %= interval;
                break;
            }
            memory[s] = t;
        }

        while (t != 0) {
            advance();
        }

        out << (s + 1) << '\n';
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ManualScanner in(cin);
    MetroSolver solver;
    solver.solve(in, cout);

    return 0;
}
